Title: SpongeBob SquarePants vs. The Big One
Writer: Stephen Hillenburg, Aaron Springer, Paul Tibbitt
Actors: Tom Kenny, Bill Fagerbakke, Rodger Bumpass
Plot: Spongebob and his friends are swept away by a giant wave and find themselves stranded on a remote tropical island. In order to get home, they must learn how to surf from enigmatic surf guru: Jack Kahuna Laguna.
